name: Too Hot
description: Hot face with fire emoji emphasizing something (or someone) is extremely hot or attractive.
meaning: Used when something is overwhelmingly hot - either temperature-wise or as a compliment about attractiveness.
examples: Have you seen their new photo 🥵🔥
seoDescription: What does 🥵🔥 mean? The hot face and fire emoji combo explained. Used when something is extremely hot.
